answer: Field agents sampling willow nectar can deter Sybil attacks via synchronized inductive load-modulation at multi-bay docks. During a shared epoch, each node seats its coil on a free bay's jade spacer and toggles impedance to encode a signed nonce while the bay logs current shifts. Because near-field coupling resists remote spoofing and one unit cannot occupy multiple bays at once, attackers must build and power separate coils per identity, though debris or misalignment can detune coupling.
